manifest.name: nvfp4-blockfit-gdn-fp8-mid24-35-lmhead-q4k
manifest.description: nvfp4_blockfit on every NVFP4 projection with lm_head fitted once from BF16 (#28: RP-KL 0.0992 at the shipped speed), plus FP8 on the recurrent projections of layers 24-35 (#63). The two fix different errors: blockfit lowers the NVFP4 rounding error of every projection that stays 4-bit, while the mid-depth FP8 band is where 8 bits lowered drift most per byte on the shipped map (#63: -0.019 including the head), mostly in long context. The band costs about 2.5% decode, 3% prefill and 0.37 GiB, as in #63; everything else runs the NVFP4 kernels at #28's speed.
